summary: Hearing (a hearing person) circles an index finger in small forward circles in front of the mouth, which comes from the idea of someone who talks.
steps: Hold your index finger horizontally in front of your lips.
Circle it forward in small loops, two or three times.
Note that it has nothing to do with the ear; the sign is about speaking.
mistakes: Pointing at the ear. That would be closer to HEAR or LISTEN, not the identity sign HEARING.
